title: Data is Your Differentiator: Building Secure and Tailored AI Systems — Mani Khanuja, AWS
talk_summary: An AWS product talk arguing that data (not models) is the differentiator for GenAI apps, walking through Bedrock Data Automation, Knowledge Bases, Guardrails, semantic caching, observability, and evaluation as a loop. It is mostly a Bedrock feature tour with a few transferable engineering principles around caching, observability, and eval-driven optimization.

takeaways.what_they_do: Cache responses keyed on semantic similarity of the query rather than exact string match, so near-duplicate questions skip the foundation model entirely.
takeaways.evidence_quote: if similar questions have been asked I don't need to go and invoke my foundation model that will charge me money

takeaways.technique: Eval-gated optimization loop with a test suite
takeaways.what_they_do: Log queries/retrievals/responses, evaluate against task-specific metrics, update data or strategy, then re-run an automated test suite before shipping.
takeaways.evidence_quote: whenever you are doing this update these evaluations have to be automatic and if you have a defined path on how you are creating this test suite

takeaways.technique: Evaluate retrieval/context before paying the model
takeaways.what_they_do: Check context relevance of retrieved chunks first; if retrieval is bad, don't send to the model at all because a bad context yields a bad answer at full cost.
takeaways.evidence_quote: if my context is not relevant, my search results are not good. doesn't make sense for me to put them in front of the model and pay

takeaways.what_they_do: Treat chunking (hierarchical/semantic/custom) as a first-class accuracy decision, not an afterthought, because it determines what the model sees.
takeaways.evidence_quote: having the right strategy will make the difference in the accuracy of the generated responses

takeaways.what_they_do: Log every user query, retrieval hit, and model response, and treat observability as a hard prerequisite before any pilot or production run.
takeaways.evidence_quote: please don't go into production or even do a pilot without observability. How will you troubleshoot?
